headline: Meta's Muse Image model accepts Instagram accounts as prompts
summary: Meta's new AI model generates images using Instagram accounts as prompts
details: Meta's new Muse Image model is available in the US through the Meta AI app, Instagram, and WhatsApp. It uses advanced reasoning to understand complex prompts and can blend multiple photos into high-quality creations.
The model can generate images in various formats and styles, and understand conversational prompts for easy editing. It can also produce functional QR codes and legible text in images.
Muse Image will power over 30 new effects for Instagram Stories and image generation in WhatsApp. It can incorporate likenesses from Instagram accounts, with controls in place for photo reuse.
The model is free for everyday creation, with a paid Meta One subscription for generating more images. Limits may vary depending on the service and location.
caption:
Can AI images include your friends now? Meta's new Muse Image model uses Instagram accounts as prompts

Meta's new Muse Image model is available in the US through the Meta AI app, Instagram, and WhatsApp. It uses advanced reasoning to understand complex prompts and can blend multiple photos into high-quality creations.

The model can generate images in various formats and styles, and understand conversational prompts for easy editing. It can also produce functional QR codes and legible text in images.

Muse Image will power over 30 new effects for Instagram Stories and image generation in WhatsApp. It can incorporate likenesses from Instagram accounts, with controls in place for photo reuse.

The model is free for everyday creation, with a paid Meta One subscription for generating more images. Limits may vary depending on the service and location.

headline_marked: Google Translate [[gets a visual overhaul]] with unified bottom bar
headline: Google Translate gets a visual overhaul with unified bottom bar
summary: New design brings main features to one easy-to-reach space
details: Google Translate is getting a new look, with a unified bottom bar that brings all the main features of the app to one easy-to-reach space. The new design includes a Translate button, Live Translation, Camera Translation, and the ability to Practice.
The language selection has been moved from the bottom to the top, making it easier to copy and paste text to get translations. The translation section is now closer to the user's thumbs.

The app also surfaces options to jump back into a practice session or continue a conversation with live translation on the main screen. A new hamburger menu provides access to 'Your activity' section, with Saves and Transcripts, as well as recent translations.
caption:
Google Translate's new design is coming soon!
